onboarding.title1: See where the risk is before there is fire
onboarding.text1: Atalaya combines weather, heat spots and fire history into one indicator for each municipality of Nariño. It is a guide, not an exact prediction.
onboarding.text2: Each municipality gets a score from 0 to 100: dry weather (50%), heat spots seen by satellite in the last 5 days (30%) and fires reported before (20%).
onboarding.locationText: Only when you tap “My location” on the map, to show your municipality.
onboarding.internetText: To bring up-to-date weather, heat spots and fire history.
onboarding.text3: Atalaya needs no account. If you don’t allow location, you can search for your municipality on the map.
map.unavailable: This phone cannot show the map. You can search for a municipality or use “My location” to see its risk.
map.boundariesError: The municipal boundaries could not be loaded. The map shows only the points.
